attchmntText: Shah Metacorp Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Shah Metacorp Limited filed a statement regarding the utilization of funds raised through a preferential issue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company confirms there was no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from the objects approved by shareholders. Equity shares were allotted to Ms. Mona Shah on July 16, 2026, September 10, 2026, and September 16, 2026, pursuant to the conversion of warrants. The total amount raised was Rs. 1554.3 Lakhs, with Rs. 518.1 Lakhs received on application. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 14, 2026. The company reports that funds were utilized for capital expenses and general corporate purposes as disclosed.

attchmntText: Shah Metacorp Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shah Metacorp Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The board also reviewed and updated the related party transaction policy. Standalone profit for the half year was Rs. 546.55 lakhs, with revenue of Rs. 9,336.10 lakhs. Consolidated profit for the period was Rs. 394.42 lakhs. The company recognized a provision for doubtful debts of Rs. 56.89 crores against trade receivables of Rs. 76.26 crores from an overseas customer. An MOU for settlement is subject to commercial considerations. The statutory auditor, Shivam Soni & Co., issued a review report with an emphasis of matter regarding the receivables. The company issued equity shares via preferential allotment and a rights issue during the period.
